column1: # W4.0 frontier walk plan — THE plan, against the W4.0 frontend.
# Re-pinned 2026-08-20 (raft W4.0, the export unblock): the raft subject tree
# exports clean with ZERO probe deltas — the terminal row is the whole plan,
# which is exactly §8's W4.0 done criterion ("frontier-plan.tsv reduces to its
# terminal row alone with no probe deltas").  What retired the 14 action rows
# of the previous plan (docs/raft-w3-log.md §2.5, the probe-delta ledger):
#   - the `lockedRand.Intn` body replacement + `crypto/rand`/`math/big` import
#     drops (H-9's stand-in): H-9 is FIXED (BUG-064 — the inittask worklist
#     carries symbol prefixes, never import paths), so the multi-package export
#     no longer refuses on the entropy prefix, and the method's verbatim body
#     now lands as an ordinary H-3 per-declaration quarantined stub.  The G-1
#     jitter draw is therefore UNMASKED: it appears in the main census with its
#     real refusal (no separate single-package probe needed to see it, though
#     sweep.py still runs one as a cross-check).
#   - the `probe/errors_new.go` injection + nine `$rewrite` rows + three
#     `$drop-import:errors` rows (G-2/G-3's stand-ins): errors.New is MODELED
#     as an E5 stdlib shim (per-unit injection), so the nine package-level
#     sentinel initializers and every in-body call site lower for real.  G-3's
#     mechanism (H-11, per-declaration quarantine for package-level vars)
#     landed in the same slice as the general backstop; nothing in this tree
#     needs it once errors.New lowers.
# The previous plan's content survives as the difference measurement in
# docs/raft-w3-log.md §2.2/§2.5 (JC-9's rule: expectations are what the
# frontend said at that step; the per-declaration causes are the census's).
